newsitem.title: USA: United confirms taps Fallon, Y&R for ads.
newsitem.headline: United confirms taps Fallon, Y&R for ads.

text.p: United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp confirmed on Friday it has selected two new advertising agencies -- Minneapolis-based Fallon McElligott and New York-based Young & Rubicam -- to coordinate its annual advertising account.
According to industry sources, the annual billings for the agencies is estimated at $100 million but United pegged the billings at $120 million in its statement.

Under terms of the new arrangement, United said it will form a strategic partnership with the two agencies to design and implement new advertising campaigns which differentiate United and create a new marketing direction for the company.
Both agencies will start on new assignments immediately.
Fallon will focus mainly on United's North American customers and Young & Rubicam on its international operations, according to a United statement.
While both agencies will be involved in media planning, Young & Rubicam is expected to handle all of the media buying.
The two agencies were awarded the business after United began an intensive review of its advertising campaign last September.
In addition to Fallon McElligott and Young & Rubicam, Leo Burnett Co and TBWA/Chiat-Day also competed in the final round of competition.
The two agencies will replace Leo Burnett, which has worked on United's business for the past 30 years and created the term, "Friendly Skies."
